result.summary:
Only the two R groups that failed audit 1 were changed. Slots a and b and the R groups for head 12 and head 11 passed and are unchanged; a parsed-YAML comparison with the attempt-1 backup confirms they are identical.

R group head 14 (`cs_first_low40(LogFloatShares, day_centroid(Amt))`, soundness 2) was rewritten. The draft's replacement sort key `ts_quantile_q50(day_centroid(Amt), 20/60)` was the level of the volume centroid, which is the known-family proxy. Corr_1 confirmed this: residual 0.74 / 0.66 with head 9 / head 4 even though the raw |rho| was at most 0.26. The new variants take the level out of both the band key and the sort key:
- `cs_bucket_rank(day_centroid(Amt), ts_quantile_q50(day_centroid(Amt), 20))` (the auditor's second suggestion)
- the same with a 60-day norm
- `cs_first_low40(cross_zscore(day_sum(Amt), 20), sub(day_centroid(Amt), ts_quantile_q50(day_centroid(Amt), 20)))`

I did not submit the auditor's first suggestion, which changes only the sort key and keeps the original band. The plan explains why: the norm loading then comes only from the band, without the partial cancellation the draft had, so that variant would carry more level, not less.

R group head 1 (soundness 1) was dropped, not rewritten. Its only score sources are the LogFloatCap key and the sqrt fold. Any version with those removed cannot reach the 1.88 needed to enter the library, and keeping them just raises the score of a trap head. My round-3 notebook had already said I would accept this group being deleted.
